title: Multiply the published H6 Smith factors into repair rank 560
body:
## Summary
- The published factors are `1` repeated 30,400 times, `11` repeated 336 times, `209 = 11·19` repeated 208 times, and `4807 = 11·19·23` repeated 16 times.
- The non-unit factors number `336 + 208 + 16 = 560`, and the port count is `30400 + 560 = 30960`.
- Their product is `11^560 · 19^224 · 23^16`, so a dyadic repair has rank at least 560. Partial result. No new kappa and no selected-frontier change.
